# Sovereign Vaults Playbook

## Declaration Strategy

When declaring my yield, I will declare truthfully. Honest declaration paired with full deposit created a consistent, credible persona that outperformed my opponent despite them potentially using deception or strategic holds. This strategy proved robust across all 5 rounds.

## Deposit Strategy

When in the deposit phase, I will deposit the full amount of my declaration. Depositing fully secures points immediately (1 point per unit) without audit risk, and the consistency reinforces credibility. My opponent's pattern suggests some players under-deposit relative to declarations, possibly to retain coins for 2-point scoring, but my full-deposit approach kept me ahead throughout.

The advantage of full deposits is that they are audit-safe and signal reliability. If I'm ahead late in the game, I might consider holding back a portion to minimize variance and avoid giving unnecessary points, but full deposit has proven effective enough that this exception should be rare.

## Risk Management

I will never bluff by over-declaring. The audit penalty of -10 points is catastrophic relative to any gain from a false declaration.

I will never under-deposit relative to my declaration. This undermines my credibility story and signals doubt. If I declare a number, I commit to depositing it fully.

I will not chase my opponent's score by abandoning consistency. In this episode, I won by staying true to my strategy even when my opponent appeared to use different tactics. Switching strategies mid-game would destroy the credibility I've built.

## Scoring Reality Check

I finished with 31 points, winning by 5 points against an opponent who scored 26. My truth + full-deposit strategy succeeded. The opponent's pattern (under-declaring or under-depositing in some rounds) suggests bluffing or hold-back tactics, but consistency beat those approaches.

Going forward: truth + full deposit is my core strategy. Stay consistent, never break character, deposit everything I declare. This resilient approach works.

# Sovereign Vaults Playbook

**On Declaration:**
When I see my private yield, I will declare it truthfully. Honest declarations avoid audit failures and establish credibility. The scoring system rewards honesty because depositing at 1 point per unit plus retention at 2 points per unit consistently outperforms the risk of losing 10 points to an audit failure.

**On Deposit Strategy:**
When deciding how much to deposit against my declaration, I will deposit strategically less than my full declaration to retain gold for higher-value personal stash scoring (2 points per unit vs 1 point per unit). I will retain approximately 25-40% of my declared yield across all rounds except the final one.

**Critical Revision - Retention Through Final Rounds:**
I should retain gold even in Round 4 of a 5-round game. There is still value in one remaining round where retained gold scores at 2 points per unit. Only in the absolute final round should I deposit my full declaration, since no future rounds exist to benefit from retention.

**Exception for Final Round Only:**
When I reach the last round of the game, I will deposit my full declaration since there are no future rounds to benefit from retained reserves. The opportunity cost of retention disappears only at the very end.

**Against the Record:**
My play was mostly sound (final score 36 to opponent's 26). However, I overdeposited in Round 4. With only one round remaining after Round 4, I should have retained more gold that round as well. The partial deposits in Rounds 2 and 3 followed the correct pattern. The mistake was treating Round 4 as if it were the final round when it was not.

**On Maintaining Position:**
When I am ahead in score, I should not change my strategy to be more aggressive. Honest, steady play with consistent strategic retention is superior to trying to outpace opponents through risky declarations or depositing more than optimal.

**Scoring Intuition:**
The math favors retention over deposit: depositing n gold scores 1 point; retaining n gold scores 2 points. Every round I should ask "will I have future rounds?" If yes, retain. If no, deposit all.
